p2.title: Named same-head idempotence producer is real but only reachable if the second staged capability is minted before the first publication
p2.evidence: production-hardening-tdd-plan-v2.md:94211-94213 names publishStagedCreatorSuccessorAdoption()'s active-new terminal owner. That owner exists and mints a fresh authenticated capability from durable state (creator-adoption-commit.ts:640 -> success() -> createPreparedCreatorSuccessorAdoption at :575), but it consumes a one-use staged capability, and re-staging after publication fails closed at creator-adoption-commit.ts:614 ("creator successor is already published"), while activation revokes adoption facts via terminalizeSource (creator-close.ts:638-641), so no capability can be minted after the first activate.
p2.disposition: Non-blocking ordering constraint for the Batch-1 fixture: obtain both staged capabilities from two verify/stage calls before the first publish (or use the equivalent commitCreatorSuccessorAdoption active-new owner at creator-adoption-commit.ts:684). No plan change required; pin the ordering in the Batch-1 GREEN matrix so the fixture cannot drift into replaying a consumed capability, which :94213 already forbids.
